steps.sql: DECLARE @s nvarchar(max)=N'['+REPLICATE(CAST(N'0,' AS nvarchar(max)),65535-1)+N'0]'; SET @s=N'{"a":'+@s+N',"b":1,"c":"padding"}'; DECLARE @j json=CAST(@s AS json); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'$.b',NULL); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'append $.a',1); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'$.b',2); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail;

DECLARE @s nvarchar(max)=N'['+REPLICATE(CAST(N'0,' AS nvarchar(max)),65536-1)+N'0]'; DECLARE @j json=CAST(@s AS json); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'$',JSON_QUERY(N'[1]')); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'append $',2); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'append $',3); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail;

DECLARE @s nvarchar(max)=N'['+REPLICATE(CAST(N'0,' AS nvarchar(max)),65536-1)+N'0]'; SET @s=N'{"a":'+@s+N',"b":1,"c":"padding"}'; DECLARE @j json=CAST(@s AS json); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'$.a',JSON_QUERY(N'[]')); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'$.c',JSON_QUERY(N'{"x":1}')); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'$.a',JSON_QUERY(N'[1]')); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail;

DECLARE @s nvarchar(max)=N'['+REPLICATE(CAST(N'0,' AS nvarchar(max)),32767-1)+N'0]'; SELECT @s=N'{'+STRING_AGG(CAST(N'"k'+[key]+N'":0' AS nvarchar(max)),N',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY CAST([key] AS int))+N'}' FROM OPENJSON(@s); DECLARE @j json=CAST(@s AS json); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'$.x',1); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'$.y',2); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'$.z',3); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail;

DECLARE @s nvarchar(max)=N'['+REPLICATE(CAST(N'0,' AS nvarchar(max)),32768-1)+N'0]'; SELECT @s=N'{'+STRING_AGG(CAST(N'"k'+[key]+N'":0' AS nvarchar(max)),N',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY CAST([key] AS int))+N'}' FROM OPENJSON(@s); DECLARE @j json=CAST(@s AS json); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'$.k0',NULL); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'$.new',1); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'$.k0',2); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail;

DECLARE @s nvarchar(max)=N'['+REPLICATE(CAST(N'0,' AS nvarchar(max)),32768-1)+N'0]'; SELECT @s=N'{'+STRING_AGG(CAST(N'"k'+[key]+N'":0' AS nvarchar(max)),N',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY CAST([key] AS int))+N'}' FROM OPENJSON(@s); DECLARE @j json=CAST(@s AS json); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'$.k0',JSON_QUERY(N'{"new":1}')); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail;

DECLARE @s nvarchar(max)=N'['+REPLICATE(CAST(N'0,' AS nvarchar(max)),32768-1)+N'0]'; SELECT @s=N'{'+STRING_AGG(CAST(N'"k'+[key]+N'":0' AS nvarchar(max)),N',') WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY CAST([key] AS int))+N'}' FROM OPENJSON(@s); DECLARE @j json=CAST(@s AS json); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail; SET @j=JSON_MODIFY(@j,'$.k0',JSON_QUERY(N'{"k1":1}')); SELECT DATALENGTH(@j) AS bytes,RIGHT(CAST(@j AS nvarchar(max)),80) AS tail;
